script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'andesim-series-v2',
  description: 'Build the fine-grained 91-commit prototype-first review series for andesim',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Build series', detail: 'one agent per commit, sequential, minimal->complete' },
    { title: 'Verify', detail: 'tree parity + build pass at tip' },
  ],
}

const SCRATCH = '/tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad'
const SPEC = SCRATCH + '/andesim_series_v2.json'
const WT = SCRATCH + '/wt/andesim'
const REPO = '/home/nick/work/andesim'
const IDS = Array.from({length: 91}, (_, i) => 'c' + String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0'))

const RES = {
  type: 'object', required: ['status', 'summary'],
  properties: {
    status: { type: 'string', enum: ['committed', 'blocked'] },
    sha: { type: 'string' },
    summary: { type: 'string' },
    deviations: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    validation_notes: { type: 'string' },
  },
}

const POLICY = `You build ONE commit of a fine-grained, prototype-first review series for the andesim repo. The series re-synthesizes 238 messy commits into 91 clean ones, with all retired/legacy code removed. Organizing rule: each functionality is built up in TWO steps -- a MINIMAL prototype commit (smallest real slice) with its test, then a COMPLETION commit (the rest) with its test. Some commits are single (atomic removals, docs, one build tweak). Your spec entry has a "slice" field: minimal | completion | single.

WORKSPACE
- Work ONLY in worktree ${WT} (branch review/andesim-series). NEVER modify ${REPO}'s main checkout or other worktrees; read-only git against ${REPO} is fine ('git -C ${WT} show <sha>' reaches all history).
- NEVER 'git push'. Only branch review/andesim-series.
- Start: 'git -C ${WT} status --short' clean (config.env + build outputs allowed untracked). End: EXACTLY ONE new commit, clean status.

SPEC
- Read ${SPEC}: your entry by id, plus top-level abi_pins, env, include_submodule_recipe, legacy_never_add, expected_delta_vs_old_tip. Substitute ${SCRATCH} for SCRATCH, ${WT} for WT.
- Final tree = branch 'andesim' ('git -C ${WT} show andesim:<path>', 'git -C ${WT} checkout andesim -- <path>'). Historical commits are reference only; the final file is the fixed form.

SLICE SEMANTICS (critical -- this makes the series reviewable)
- slice=minimal: code genuinely does ONLY the small slice, and its test checks ONLY that slice. E.g. "Andes CSR drain+verify, min (mxstatus)" drains + verifies ONLY mxstatus (hand-coded, not the X-macro loop); "runtime crt0/UART, min" only makes vplat_hello print, no exit/file-io yet; "fixtures, min (one C fixture)" relinks ONE fixture. You author a genuinely reduced version, NOT the final file.
- slice=completion: expand the prior minimal slice to full final form and extend the test to cover all. After it, the touched file matches final MINUS still-later-feature parts.
- slice=single: author to final form minus later-feature parts, per construct. Removal commits ('refactor!: remove ...') delete the named subsystem.
- The construct field says exactly what reduced/full content to write and how to derive it from the final file.

INCLUDE/ SUBMODULE: at the ABI-pin commit (spec functionality abi-submodule, ~c010) replace the in-tree include/hybrid headers with the andesim_abi submodule using include_submodule_recipe: 'git rm -r' the in-tree headers, remove leftover include/, 'git -C ${REPO}/include worktree add --detach ${WT}/include <v2 sha>', 'git -C ${WT} add include' + the .gitmodules entry (copy from final tree). To advance the pin later (v3/v4/v5/v6 commits): 'git -C ${WT}/include checkout <sha>' then 'git -C ${WT} add include'. Never make include/ a plain tracked dir after that.

BUILD-ORDER FACTS: ABI structs/macros exist only after their pin (hybrid_andes_csr after v3 ~c050, hybrid_m_ext_csr after v4 ~c054, hybrid_l2c after v5 ~c072, write_mask.h after v6 ~c074). Do not reference a not-yet-pinned symbol. The real external vsim first interoperates at the v6 pin (~c074/c075) -- a real e2e smoke is EXPECTED to fail before then (record, do not gate); it must PASS from the write-mask commit on. NEVER introduce a legacy_never_add item.

VALIDATION ENV: export QEMU_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/qemu_andesim/build/qemu VSIM_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=/home/nick/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d and PATH as needed. ${WT}/config.env already exists.
- Run every validate item in your spec entry from ${WT}. Cheap standing checks once pieces exist: 'make -C qemu_plugin', the driver build + unit-test subset (see scripts/test_all.sh), 'make -C runtime', 'make -C tests/fixtures'. 'EXPECTED TO FAIL' notes mean record, don't gate.
- If validation cannot pass, DO NOT commit broken: fix it or return status=blocked with detail.

COMMIT MESSAGE: first line = spec subject verbatim. Blank line. Body = 2-6 full sentences from body_points (what + why; note the minimal/completion step so a reviewer sees the build-up). End with exactly:

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

REPORT: status/sha (git rev-parse --short HEAD)/summary + EVERY deviation.`

phase('Build series')
const done = []
for (const id of IDS) {
  const r = await agent(
    POLICY + `\n\nYOUR COMMIT: ${id}\n\nCommits already in the series (oldest first): ${JSON.stringify(done)}\n\nBuild ${id} now.`,
    { label: id, phase: 'Build series', schema: RES }
  )
  if (!r || r.status !== 'committed' || !r.sha) {
    log(`ABORTED at ${id}: ${r ? r.summary : 'agent died'}`)
    return { status: 'aborted', at: id, reason: r, done }
  }
  done.push({ id, sha: r.sha, dev: (r.deviations || []).join('; ').slice(0, 200) })
  log(`${id} -> ${r.sha}`)
}

phase('Verify')
const VER = {
  type: 'object', required: ['verdict', 'issues'],
  properties: {
    verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['clean', 'issues-found'] },
    issues: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    delta_report: { type: 'string' },
    build_report: { type: 'string' },
  },
}
const v = await agent(`Verify the finished 91-commit series on branch review/andesim-series in worktree ${WT} (repo ${REPO}; never push; do not touch other checkouts).

1. TREE PARITY: 'git -C ${WT} diff andesim HEAD --name-status'. Read ${SPEC} expected_delta_vs_old_tip. Every D on the deleted list, every M/A on the edited list; include/ gitlink at the v6 pin. For each edited file read the full diff and confirm ONLY sanctioned removals/text fixes; quote anything else.
2. BUILD PASS at tip (env: QEMU_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/qemu_andesim/build/qemu VSIM_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=/home/nick/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d): make -C qemu_plugin; driver build + unit/contract subset; make -C runtime; make -C tests/fixtures. All green.
3. SERIES QUALITY + PROTOTYPE-FIRST: 'git -C ${WT} log --reverse --oneline 16a8c53..HEAD'. Confirm the minimal->completion pattern reads cleanly. Flag: message/diff contradictions, add-then-delete churn, any minimal commit that actually contains the full implementation, off-topic file touches, any commit that references a not-yet-pinned ABI symbol.
Return the structured verdict; be exhaustive.`,
  { label: 'verify', phase: 'Verify', schema: VER })

return { status: 'complete', done, verify: v }
